name: unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self
rule: It is permitted to call `Weak::from_raw` when the strong count is 0, provided `ptr` originated from `Weak::into_raw`, still owns its potential weak reference, and points to memory allocated by the global allocator; pointers originating from `Weak::new` own nothing and are also supported.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > alloc::rc::Weak < T > { unsafe fn from_raw (ptr : * const T) -> Self }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express pointer origin or continued ownership of a potential weak reference, so no faithful complete expression is available.
